delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the settlement amount agreed in writing by the parties (the “Settlement Amount”), in accordance with payment instructions and timing to be set out in the executed agreement. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
